name: 8-Pillar Diligence Scorecard
description: Weighted aggregation across 8 diligence pillars (clinical, regulatory, competitive, manufacturing, IP, financial, team, and the novel computational-infrastructure pillar). Red flags auto-cap the recommendation; green flags lift it. The 8th pillar is the methodology's differentiation: it explicitly prices a biotech's AI/ML/data assets as a value driver, which no standard BD scorecard does.
